blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) narrates, “Rasulullah ﷺ would go along the row from one end to the other, stroking our chests and shoulders with his blessed hand, and straighten the saffs (rows). And the Prophet ﷺ would say, “Do not be ahead or behind (in the rows); if the row is not straight, disagreement will arise in your hearts with one another. Allah showers mercy on those in the front rows, and the angels make du'a seeking forgiveness for them.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَي الَّذِينَ يَلُونَ الصُّفُوفَ اْلأُوَلَ، وَمَامِنْ خُطْوَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَي اللهِ مِنْ خُطْوَةٍ يَمْشِيهَا يَصِلُ بِهَا صَفّاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب في الصلوة تقام....، رقم: ٥٤٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Allah showers mercy on those in the row next to the front rows, and the angels make du'a for them. No step is more beloved to Allah than the step taken to fill an empty place in the row.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَي مَيَامِنِ الصُّفُوفِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب من يستحب ان يلي الامام في الصف.....، رقم:٦٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah showers mercy on those standing on the right side of the rows, and the angels make du'a for their forgiveness.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ عَمَّرَ جَانِبَ
